_comment: Listening rotation. The app picks the least-used item each day; 'Pick another' moves down the list. Set verify:false once you've checked a link. type: podcast | youtube | radio | show. level is a rough CEFR label.

items.name: InnerFrench podcast
items.notes: Slow, clear French on interesting topics. The best default for your level.

items.name: RFI · Journal en français facile
items.notes: 10-minute news bulletin in simple French, with transcripts. Listen once without, once with the transcript.

items.name: Easy French (YouTube)
items.notes: Street interviews with French and English subtitles. Real, fast, everyday speech.

items.name: Coffee Break French
items.notes: Structured lessons. Use the later seasons; earlier ones will feel too easy.

items.name: A French show on Netflix + Language Reactor
items.notes: French audio, French subtitles, English below. Ideas: Lupin, Dix pour cent (Call My Agent!), Le Bureau des légendes. Availability varies by country.

items.name: TV5Monde · Apprendre le français
items.notes: Short news and culture videos with comprehension exercises, sorted by level.

items.name: Easy French Podcast
items.notes: Two hosts chatting in natural French about daily life in France.

items.name: Français Authentique
items.notes: Clear, slightly slow French focused on spoken expressions.

items.name: Duolingo French Podcast
items.notes: True stories told in easy French with short English narration.

items.name: France Culture
items.notes: Native-speed radio. A stretch goal: pick a short segment on a topic you know well.
